objective: The training kit moves with the animal that trains (decision 0067): the barbell is lifted, a ram swings, the boulder is shoved, straw men lurch, the great crystal turns, flames flicker, runes and channels pulse, steam rises, throwers lob balls, a runner kicks up dust and a swimmer splashes. The Animals menu greys out a training ground another animal is using. The Speed Track loses its finish gantry and its bench.
acceptance_criteria: Each station's kit moves in time with the clip of the animal training there, and rests when none does
The barbell and a ram come to the height of the animal that uses them
In the Animals menu a ground another animal is training at is greyed out and says so; the animal's own ground and free grounds look as before
The Speed Track has no finish gantry and no bench; its chequered line is still on the ground
Nothing shown decides or delays any training
